intro.text: A highly ranked Fused scholar, one of the fannahn-im, who proposes that the singers seize Urithiru from the humans.
The leader of the Fused occupation of Urithiru, who puts Navani Kholin to work on research into Light.
Working with Navani, she develops Warlight along with anti-Stormlight and anti-Voidlight.

items.text: Raboniel was once known as the Lady of Pains, but she disliked the title and came to be called the Lady of Wishes instead.

During the last Return she created a disease meant to kill every human on Roshar. Though it affected singers too she released it anyway, but it killed fewer than one human in ten, and one singer in a hundred.
She had a daughter, Essu, and hoped that working together would keep them both sane, but Essu went mad.

Raboniel proposed to the Nine that the singers seize Urithiru, saying she could turn the tower's defences against the Radiants and suppress their powers. She led the invading force, which included Venli, Rothan, stormform singers and a group of Deepest Ones.
Leshwi offered Venli to Raboniel as her Voice, hoping to learn about her through Venli. Raboniel saw through the scheme but accepted Venli anyway.

At Urithiru, Raboniel began corrupting the Sibling with Voidlight, which strained her badly, and managed to turn the tower's defences as planned. She ordered her forces to kill only those who resisted and to gather the unconscious Radiants, gave the Pursuer leave to hunt Kaladin, and had Navani taken alive as a useful resource. She also realised that the Sibling was only pretending to be dead, and began secretly listening when it spoke to others.

Raboniel let the humans keep living in the tower and trading, though all were demoted to darkeyed status and forbidden weapons. Navani accepted the terms after Raboniel warned that otherwise the singers would kill the Radiants and rule more harshly.

Leaving most decisions to the Pursuer, Raboniel turned to research, determined to discover anti-Voidlight, and gave Navani a full lab and her scholars to help. Navani told her about the fabrials behind the flying ship, and Raboniel explained that some spren had manifested as Soulcasters.

Raboniel came upon Kaladin while corrupting the Sibling. After he defeated the Pursuer, she stabbed him to study his Radiant healing and questioned him about how the tower affected his Surges. She also met with Mraize, who offered her a captured Lift in exchange for use of the Oathgates, and reluctantly agreed to Venli's request to have Rlain released into her care.

By listening to Navani and the Sibling, Raboniel found the node in the well, but Kaladin destroyed it before she could corrupt it. She talked Navani out of giving up her research, and, singing the rhythms of Honor and Odium together, they combined Stormlight and Voidlight for the first time. Raboniel named the new rhythm the Rhythm of War and revealed her true aim: a Light that could act against Investiture. The two began keeping a shared lab notebook.

At Navani's request Raboniel gave her a raysium dagger, which led them to discover that splitting a spren between gemstones multiplied force. She also showed Navani sand from Taldain that measured Investiture, and told her of Braize and of travel between worlds through Shadesmar.

With the Sibling's corruption almost complete, Raboniel released Venli from her service. She told her that the listeners who had fled into the chasms before the Everstorm had survived, and gave her a writ for supplies.

When Navani found a tone that repelled Voidlight, Raboniel discovered the breakthrough and drew her back into collaboration, and together they created anti-Voidlight. Raboniel had it put into a raysium dagger and used it to kill Essu as a mercy, weeping over her daughter. She then revealed that her true goal was a way to kill spren permanently, and used Navani's work to create anti-Stormlight.

When Raboniel went to finish corrupting the Sibling, she gave Navani a chance to escape. Navani instead lured her into a trap and stabbed her with anti-Voidlight. Weakened but alive, Raboniel praised the trick and urged Navani to flee with the research, and Navani realised Raboniel would rather see Odium's forces lose than let the war go on forever.

When Moash attacked Navani, Raboniel clawed at him to buy her time and stabbed him with a reversed dagger to drain his Stormlight. Afterwards she asked Navani to kill her, since most of her soul was burned away and she would return insane. Navani did so reverently, holding her hand and attuning the Rhythm of War with her as she died, and left a note on her body calling her a hero.

appearance.text: A very tall, narrow femalen Fused with red and black marbled skin, a topknot of red-orange hairstrands, very long arms and fingers, and carapace like a helmet and along her arms and chest. She wears all sorts of fashions, from ornate robes and travel leathers to havah-like garments and Thaylen clothing, with no regard for gender.

personality.text: Raboniel is a curious, scholarly Fused with a particular interest in the Radiants, their powers and Urithiru. After seven thousand years she remains reasonably sane, but she is weary of the endless war between Fused and Radiants and is set on ending it.
She is skilled at manipulation and plans far ahead, which makes even other Fused wary of her.

She looks down on humans, though she admires their fabrials and comes to suspect she has underestimated them. She disdains their art and gender roles, and finds covering her safehand for their comfort annoying.

She is perhaps the most knowledgeable of the Fused about fabrials and Lights, knows something of other worlds and their arcane items, and picks up languages quickly, speaking Alethi and writing the women's script.
